description: Invoice history (newest 200 at most), each with the currency it was issued in. Filter by text, client, paid status or issue-date range. unpaid_totals has one figure per currency; unpaid_total is only set when every match is in one currency.

client.description: Only this client: id or exact name

issued_from.description: Only invoices issued on or after this date

issued_to.description: Only invoices issued on or before this date

query.description: Matches number, client, notes, project names and entry notes

sort.description: newest/oldest by issue date, highest/lowest by total

status.description: Filter by whether the invoice has been paid

name: list_invoices

unpaid_total.description: Still unpaid across the matches, in their currency; null when the matches use more than one currency

unpaid_totals.description: Still unpaid per currency code, e.g. { USD: 150 }

title: List invoices
